name: Rooted 289-Vertex Peeling Factor
definition: The supplied vertex set `rooted_example.json` defines an ample family $R\subseteq Q_{12}$ rooted at the zero word. Coordinates are bit positions of the integer vertex encodings.
parameters: $|R|=289$, the ambient cube has dimension twelve, and the distinguished root is $0$.
properties: $R$ is ample and corner-peelable, but no peeling ends at its root. The root is its only initial corner and has degree three. There is a peeling ending at vertex $2$. Every one of its 24 elementary root-preserving restrictions and contractions peels to the induced root.
